dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge (left-facing) exhibits a strong concave spline interrupted by a distinct, semi-circular notch located approximately 45% of the distance from the base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius; the highest point exhibits a smooth curvature rather than an acute point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge (right-facing) presents a smooth convex contour with an approximate 40-degree angular slope relative to the horizontal base axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible fin base width is approximately 1.7 times the vertical height from base to apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, irregular notch is present on the trailing edge; extensive white and grey mottled depigmentation or epidermal scarring is visible across the lower third of the fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast light-colored patterning at the posterior base provides a unique visual identifier against the dark dorsal coloration.
